description: What intake admission (.github/scripts/intake-triage/admit.mjs) requires before it adds agent-ready to an issue apply-verdict set to status: ready (#9212's ten criteria, owner decision Q51). Agents may change it; no floor or sync binds it (owner decision 2026-10-22). `parent-container-labels` marks a spec container parent, which /work-items:decompose always labels needs-human, so needs-human on it does not hold its children; it must hold the tracker binding's container label (docs/conventions/work-items.yaml tracker.config.container_label, default spec-container), and a missing key reads as empty.
